BUG / BUILD 125A

Title:
CEO Approval Workflow

Problem:

Operations can enter AWAITING_APPROVAL, but there is no mechanism in the Command Center UI for the CEO to approve or reject them.

Requirements:

1. Detect when an operation status is AWAITING_APPROVAL.

2. Display two buttons:

   Approve
   Reject

3. On Approve:
   - update operation status to APPROVED
   - notify the worker runtime
   - resume execution
   - log approval time
   - log approving user

4. On Reject:
   - update status to REJECTED
   - stop execution
   - record rejection reason (optional)
   - notify the worker

5. Refresh the UI automatically after approval or rejection.

6. Preserve the existing governance model.

7. Do not bypass protected actions.

Success Criteria:

A CEO can approve a protected engineering task directly from the Miles Command Center and the operation resumes automatically without restarting the system.

Priority: P0 (Highest)

Mission

Do NOT build any new capabilities.

Do NOT use the Autonomous Capability Builder.

Do NOT create a BUSINESS_EXECUTION operation until you have classified the user's intent.

Your task is to inspect and repair the Command Center request routing.

Problem

Every user request is currently being routed to:

BUSINESS_EXECUTION

This is incorrect.

Questions, conversations, audits, and commands are all being treated as BUSINESS_EXECUTION.

This prevents Executive Conversation, CEO Approvals, and normal interaction.

Required Actions
Inspect the code path from the "Give this to Miles" button to the execution engine.
Identify:
The file handling the button click.
The file creating the BUSINESS_EXECUTION operation.
The file routing user requests.
The file responsible for intent classification (if one exists).
Determine why every request becomes BUSINESS_EXECUTION.
Implement an Intent Router before any operation is created.

The router must classify requests into:

QUESTION
COMMAND
APPROVAL
AUDIT
CONVERSATION

Behavior:

QUESTION → answer naturally.
COMMAND → create BUSINESS_EXECUTION.
APPROVAL → approval workflow.
AUDIT → inspect/report without creating BUSINESS_EXECUTION.
CONVERSATION → converse naturally.
Rules
Reuse existing code whenever possible.
Do not redesign the architecture.
Do not add new frameworks.
Do not modify providers.
Do not modify ORION.
Do not modify Instantly.
Only modify the routing layer.
Deliverable

Return:

Files inspected.
Root cause.
Files modified.
Tests performed.
